title: Cosmological Constraints from Strong Gravitational Lensing in Clusters of Galaxies

evidence.locator: Abstract: a parametric model of the mass distribution of Abell 1689 from Hubble images and ground-based spectroscopy of its lensed galaxies. ESA/Hubble release heic1014 accompanies the paper and shows the mass distribution of the lens over a Hubble picture (heic1014a).
